about: Agent host falsifiers: each entry breaks one check (exact text, replaced once), and every named test must then FAIL. Run with falsify.py. expect: caught (all named tests fail), compile_error (the mutation must not build), survives (known survivor, by design). Files are relative to examples/agent-host. command: host (cargo test of the guest) or e2e (run-e2e.sh: the guest in a test Runtime).

falsifiers.title: the shrink rule is gone: a long summary replaces the tail
a required fact may be dropped
a summary may repeat the system head (node 0)
a model failure is recorded as a summary
a summary is recorded from a step that was never dispatched
a settled summary step accepts another answer
a delayed answer erases history the request never saw
compaction replaces node 0 instead of keeping the head
a model failure writes history instead of leaving it unchanged
